{"id":1415081370,"question_id":3206,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 9 months","timestamp":1728325058,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"26 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1415081370/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Common Elements Between Two Arrays","memory":"64.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> findIntersectionValues(vector<int>& nums1, vector<int>& nums2) {\n      int count1 = 0;\n        int count2 = 0;\n        vector<int> ans;\n\n        int n1 = nums1.size();\n        int n2 = nums2.size();\n\n        for(int i=0;i<n1;i++)\n        {\n            for(int j=0;j<n2;j++)\n            {\n                if(nums1[i] == nums2[j])\n                {\n                    count1++;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        for(int i=0;i<n2;i++)\n        {\n            for(int j=0;j<n1;j++)\n            {\n                if(nums2[i] == nums1[j])\n                {\n                    count2++;\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        ans.push_back(count1);\n        ans.push_back(count2);\n\n        return ans;  \n       \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-common-elements-between-two-arrays","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":46}
